array spread in constructor - not flagged (only object-literal spread targeted)

valid.code: class Foo { method(x) { const merged = { ...x }; return merged; } }
valid.name: object spread in a method never called by the constructor - not flagged

valid.code: class Foo { constructor() {} method(x) { const merged = { ...x }; return merged; } }

object spread outside any class - not flagged
